column1: # Agility shortcuts: loc, op, level, xp, ticks, origin tile, destination tile, requirements.
# Tiles, levels and gates come from the shortest-path RuneLite plugin's
# Copyright (c) 2021 Skretzo. Xp is the wiki's, matched by loc id. Every loc, varbit and varp
# id was resolved to this cache's gameval symbols at generation time, so no raw id is here.
# Requirements are ';' separated: another skill (ranged=37), gear (gear=grapple) with the
# Agility level that crosses without it (bare=48), a quest
# (quest=quest_regicide, checked through the realm's quest requirement mode) or a raw var
# A shortcut that can be failed carries its odds out of 256, the xp a fail still pays and the
# damage it deals, as low/high/failxp/damage - the wiki's numbers, blank where it cannot fail.
